method: manual edge picks on zoomed, contrast-enhanced crops (grid overlay), perspective-corrected with a pinhole model

original_photo_1280x720.view: snout axis ~61 deg from the line of sight (most side-on view)
original_photo_1280x720.note: side-edge angle is inside the measurement noise (about +-2 deg); the width ratio is the usable number

three_quarter_photo_1080x2400.view: axis ~24 deg from the line of sight (mouth nearly face-on, ellipse 93 x 102 px)
three_quarter_photo_1080x2400.note: ill-conditioned: root silhouette merges with the face/fillet in a near-axial view; not used

front_photo_1080x2400.note: axial view, taper not measurable; mouth ~0.33 x head width after perspective (~68-72 mm)
